title: Declaration of Breaking the Game
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone thought the situation was settled, two subtle Spiritual Energy fluctuations quietly transmitted—Su Qingyao and Ye Qing almost simultaneously sent him messages. What was even more unsettling was that in the corner of the crowd, an elderly gaze pierced through the void, firmly locked onto him.

text.content: As everyone waited for Chen Ji's answer, he suddenly laughed—that smile was cold and mocking, as if watching a troupe of clowns delivering a拙劣 performance. The laughter wasn't loud, yet it echoed particularly clearly in the silent great hall, striking the hearts of everyone present, causing representatives of the three powers who had been confident of success to freeze in unison. 'Interesting,' he slowly stood up, his servant disciple's robes swaying gently in the wind, 'Tianqing Sect wants my allegiance, Xuanwu Sect wants my submission, Holy Sect wants my cooperation—gentlemen, what do you take me, Chen Ji, for? A stray dog picked up from the roadside?'

dialogue.content: The offers from all of you are quite generous—Tianqing Sect promises me a position as Inner Disciple, Xuanwu Sect bestows core inheritance, and Holy Sect immediately proposes me as the Sacred Maiden's protector. What virtue do I, Chen Ji, possess that three major powers would favor me simultaneously?

text.content: His voice was unhurried, each word like a stone dropped into a calm lake, creating layers of ripples. The representatives of the three powers' expressions slightly changed—they had thought that atrash disciple, with just a slight extension of the olive branch, would gratefully kneel in allegiance. Yet they hadn't expected the other party to not only fail to show gratitude but also publicly tear apart this 'good deed' for everyone to see—this was no different from slapping their faces. That genius Han Lie from Xuanwu Sect frowned tightly, and had it not been for the elder holding him back, he might have exploded on the spot.

dialogue.content: Waste! Do you know what you're saying? The olive branch from Xuanwu Sect—how many people in the entire Eastern Domain can receive it? You actually dare to be picky?

Han-shixiong speaks rightly,' Chen Ji turned to Han Lie, his gaze calm as still water, 'so I would like to ask—if I choose Xuanwu Sect today, during the secret realm competition three days later, will Xuanwu Sect stand behind me, or continue to use this 'trash' as cannon fodder?' He paused, 'I suppose it's the latter. After all, what value does atrash have? Using it up and throwing it away—isn't that what you all do best?'

text.content: This speech plunged the great hall into an eerie silence. Everyone could hear it—the servant disciple called atrash simply didn't trust any party. His gaze was too clear, too composed, as if he had long since seen through all three parties' trump cards. The Holy Sect representative Ye Qing's eyes flickered with an unusual gleam; she was the only one who hadn't spoken, quietly watching this 'trash' who was completely different from the intelligence reports.

dialogue.content: Then in your opinion, what should be done?

text.content: Ye Qing's voice was cold as frost, yet carried a hint of playfulness. Her opening caused the other two parties to immediately become vigilant—could the Holy Sect's Sacred Maiden actually initiate conversation with atrash disciple? There must be something蹊跷 here. And what surprised people more was that Chen Ji's gaze when looking at Ye Qing actually carried some indescribable, complex emotions.

dialogue.content: How?' Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, his voice echoing in the empty great hall, 'I only do things that benefit myself! You all want to play chess? Fine. But why should I be the chess piece, rather than you all being my chess pieces?'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji publicly declared he would take the fourth path, catching the three powers off guard. Want to see how he further intimidates the entire audience?

choices.text: Retreat to Advance, Show Weakness to Entice the Enemy
choices.description: On the surface, be respectful and modest, actually hide a sharp edge, letting the enemy relax their guard before striking a lethal blow.

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, 'I am merely a servant disciple, how would I dare compete with all you seniors? Just...' His tone shifted, 'Though I am weak, I am not a soft persimmon to be squeezed at will. If anyone bullies me too much, I will repay it a hundredfold.' This speech appeared to show weakness but actually set a bottom line, making everyone reassess this 'trash's' true weight.

choices.text: Direct Confrontation, Overwhelm the Entire Audience
choices.description: Press down on everyone with absolute momentum, revealing a glimpse of true strength, making everyone realize he is by no means an ordinary person.
choices.visible_reward: Shock the entire audience, hostility turns to reverence

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly stepped forward, his momentum suddenly rising. Though it was only Foundation Building early stage Spiritual Energy fluctuation, it carried an indescribable sense of oppression—tempered through life and death, the bearing of someone whose calculations never miss. The air in the great hall seemed to solidify, Han Lie from Xuanwu Sect's pupils sharply contracted, instinctively retreating half a step. For the first time, he realized thistrash was probably far more dangerous than he had imagined.

choices.text: Sow Discord, Use Others to Kill
choices.description: Not directly taking a stance, but using words to sharpen the contradictions between the three parties, causing them to mutually suspect and destroy each other.
choices.visible_reward: The three parties exhaust each other
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will become target of public criticism

dialogue.content: Do you all know who Xuanwu Sect and Holy Sect sent for this secret realm competition?' Chen Ji suddenly threw out a question, 'Within Tianqing Sect, who is the one passing information to you all?' He didn't give an answer, but his meaningful gaze swept between the three parties' representatives, instantly igniting seeds of suspicion. The Xuanwu Sect elder's eyes suddenly darkened, the Holy Sect representative's expression slightly changed, and even the Tianqing Sect elders began eyeing each other.

text.content: The atmosphere in the great hall had dropped to freezing point. The three powers' representatives looked at each other in dismay, none had expected atrash servant disciple to be so presumptuous. But what made them even more uneasy was the certainty in the other party's eyes—as if everything was under his control, as if no one could escape his chess game. Ye Qing's lips slightly curved upward—this man... was indeed exactly as described in the intelligence—or rather, a hundred times more interesting than the intelligence.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, what exactly do you want?

text.content: Su Qingyao finally spoke, her voice cold but carrying a hint of curiosity she herself hadn't noticed. She was the only person who had seen Chen Ji's 'true appearance'—three months ago on a rainy night, she had encountered thistrash disciple talking to himself while facing a withered grass, his gaze deep and terrifying. At that moment, she knew this person was definitely notrash. But she hadn't expected the other party to hide so deeply, so deeply that even the three major powers were being manipulated in his palm.

dialogue.content: What do I want?' Chen Ji turned, his gaze meeting Su Qingyao's for the first time, 'What does Su-shimei think?' He paused, his voice suddenly dropping, 'What I want has never been any of your charity. Do you all know what the three words 'Tianji Record' mean?' This was said without context, yet Ye Qing's eyes suddenly changed—she was the only person who knew the weight of these three words.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji threw out the three words 'Tianji Record,' and Ye Qing was clearly touched. How do you want to handle this critical moment?

choices.text: Touch on the Point, Leave Suspense
choices.description: Only reveal key clues, don't expose the truth, letting all factions fall into speculation and fear.
choices.risk_hint: May be traced by those with ulterior motives

text.content: 'Tianji Record?' Chen Ji softly repeated, a meaningful arc curling at the corner of his lips, 'If all of you are interested, feel free to investigate. Chen Xuan three hundred years ago, Zhou Wuming twenty years ago, Li Chenzhou ten years ago—these people, all relate to these three words.' He didn't say more, just quietly watching everyone's expressions change. These names were merely legends to most present, but some would realize the terror within.

choices.text: Lay Everything on the Table, Shock the Entire Audience
choices.description: Directly reveal the Tianji Record Fragment, letting everyone witness how terrifying the true treasure is.
choices.visible_reward: The three parties completely dare not act rashly

dialogue.content: Saying this, Chen Ji slowly took out a yellowed page from his bosom. On that page, runes flowed, and an ancient aura instantly enveloped the entire great hall. Even if just a fragment, that sense of oppression as if capable of piercing Heavenly Secrets made everyone present momentarily hold their breath. 'This is the Tianji Record,' his voice was calm as still water, 'Do you all still want to recruit me?' At these words, both the Xuanwu Sect and Holy Sect representatives simultaneously stepped back, and even the Tianqing Sect elders who had been feigning composure changed expressions.

text.content: A pin dropping could be heard in the great hall. The feelings of the three powers' representatives at this moment could no longer be expressed in words—shock, greed, fear, wariness, various emotions intertwined, leaving them temporarily unsure how to react. And Chen Ji simply stood quietly in place, allowing everyone to observe him, his eyes carrying a hint of compassion—as if gazing upon a group of chess pieces destined to be eliminated.

dialogue.content: Impossible! This must be fake!' Han Lie was the first to regain composure, 'How could atrash possibly possess the Tianji Record—this is an ancient supreme treasure, a forbidden object that even Great Ones in legends cannot approach! You must be bluffing!'

text.content: Bluffing?' Chen Ji smiled lightly, casually tossing that page into the air. The page floated in the center of the great hall, and as the runes flowed, countless images appeared—those were replays of scenes within the next three hours, terrifyingly clear. Everyone present saw their own choices and fates within the next three hours, but uniquely could not see Chen Ji's—as if he simply didn't exist within this causal web. 'Do you all think this is bluffing?'

Silence. Deathly silence. Everyone was completely shocked by this scene. The prophetic ability of the Tianji Record was something everyone present had heard of, but seeing it in person was another matter entirely. Especially that ability to remain unseen in fate's gaze—what did it mean? The old foxes present knew perfectly well: this young man was simply not on Heaven's chessboard; he was the Chess Player.

dialogue.content: Therefore,' Chen Ji retracted the fragment, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable authority, 'there's no need to waste any more effort. I will not join any party, nor will I oppose any party. I only do things that benefit myself—and right now, what benefits me most is letting all of you compete according to your own abilities in this chaotic world.' He surveyed the surroundings, a meaningful arc curling at the corner of his lips, 'The secret realm competition three days later, I look forward to seeing all of your performances.

text.content: Saying this, Chen Ji turned and walked toward the hall exit. His silhouette stretched long in the sunset's afterglow, the servant disciple's blue robes fluttered in the wind, actually carrying an otherworldly aura. No one present dared to stop him, not even find the courage to call out. Until his figure completely vanished beyond the hall doors, the suppressed murmuring suddenly erupted like a dam breaking. The three powers' representatives looked at each other, all seeing the same wariness in each other's eyes—thistrash, no, this Chess Player, was a hundred times more terrifying than they had imagined.

And in a corner unseen by others, a jade slip suddenly appeared in Su Qingyao's sleeve. Ye Qing's fingertips also felt a faint warmth—that was some ancient method of communication. They exchanged a glance, both seeing the same message in each other's eyes: this man is worth following. At the same time, deep within the forbidden grounds of Tianqing Sect's Back Mountain, a pair of turbid old eyes slowly opened, the ancient voice carrying a sinister chuckle: 'Interesting... has the inheritor of the Tianji Record finally appeared?'
